title: HB1607 (2020 Regular): Public Safety - Permit to Carry, Wear, or Transport a Handgun - Qualifications

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Maryland text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2020RS/bills/hb/hb1607f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader as filed; no vote on record. Only the one clause at (a)(6)(ii) is changed; the rest of § 5-306(a) is existing law.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-306(a)(6)(ii)): has good and substantial reason to wear, carry, or transport a handgun, such as PERSONAL PROTECTION, SELF–DEFENSE, OR a finding that the permit is necessary as a reasonable precaution against apprehended danger.
